name: Deathguard Bartholomew
summary: In Brill, Deathguard Bartholomew keeps watch over the town and helps travelers find their way. He helps keep order among the Forsaken defenders of Tirisfal Glades.

sections.title: Sentinel of Brill
sections.body: Deathguard Bartholomew keeps watch in Brill, part of the Forsaken guard defending Tirisfal Glades. Like other Deathguards, he protects reclaimed land from the lingering Scourge, fanatical Scarlet Crusaders, and other threats to Lady Sylvanas's domain. He also guides travelers around the town and helps keep order among the newly risen.

faq.answer: Deathguard Bartholomew guards Brill in Tirisfal Glades. He watches over the town and guides travelers to places they need to find.

faq.q: What is the role of the Deathguard?
faq.answer: The Deathguard is the Forsaken's main infantry and defense force. They patrol Lordaeron, defend settlements like Brill from the Scourge and Scarlet Crusade, and keep order for the Dark Lady.
Yes. Deathguard Bartholomew can direct travelers to facilities in Brill, including trainers, the inn, and profession vendors.

angles.text: As a newly liberated Forsaken from Deathknell, you first meet Lady Sylvanas's standing army through guards like Bartholomew in Brill.
As an ally arriving from Kalimdor, you can ask Bartholomew for directions through Brill's mist-shrouded streets.
